name: Benaiah
overview: The name Benaiah appears multiple times in Scripture, identifying several individuals across different tribes and roles. Notably, Benaiah is mentioned as the father of Pelatiah, a prince among the people in Ezekiel’s vision, whose death provoked a heartfelt lament over Israel’s fate (Ezekiel 11:1, 13). Additionally, the name is found among various clans in Ezra’s record, including the sons of Parosh, Pahath-moab, and Nebo, indicating the presence of Levites and leaders bearing this name during the post-exilic period. These references highlight Benaiah as a figure connected to leadership and priestly lineage within God’s covenant community.
